scope: R136 Oracle exploratory screening; physical router confirmation required

selection.meaning: Exploratory prioritization only; not promotion, a fixed registration tail, or proof of no regression.
selection.reason: Combined has negative paired-median mean and daemon CPU direction in each CPU pair/affinity/lane. Event CPU reductions are broader than the individual candidates; registration tail remains mixed.
selection.sendmmsg_raw: Not selected for router timing: daemon CPU paired medians increase in every CPU-pair/affinity/lane; mean usually increases too.
selection.standalone_candidates: path, entry and strings remain separate measured candidates; no automatic composition based only on source-level reasoning.

correctness_notes.original_example_compile_failure: Source01 path/combined changed set_path to borrow bytes but left two example call sites passing Vec; the initial path full-target build failed and is retained.
correctness_notes.example_recheck: Separate source02 overlays compiled all nine ubusd examples and the unit target for path/combined; examples were not executed. The relative profile_support include was copied from db6a6b6 into the test overlay because the reduced source snapshot omitted that shared diagnostic module.
correctness_notes.runtime_input_unchanged: source02 differs from source01 only in the two examples; all frozen measured runtime binaries remain identified above.

limitations: CPU pairs are reported separately; concurrent workers share host caches and scheduler resources.
Each subject keeps one daemon for all lanes and affinity conditions within a block.
Absolute paired median <= 1% is unresolved; larger changes are descriptive directions only.
Register and event lanes use real socket protocol but Oracle rankings do not predict router acceptance.
All raw latency samples, CPU snapshots, subject results, and failed executions remain archived.
The archive verifies recorded identities; live ELF/library hashing is asserted by the runner and is not independently repeated by this offline report.
The four blocks are exploratory repeated observations, not a significance test. Oracle shared-cache, kernel and CPU behavior may differ from the router.
All positive paired medians are included, even when within the +/-1% unresolved band. No samples or windows were excluded.
This public derivative contains no process identifiers, boot identifiers, machine paths, raw packet content or raw device observations.
